title: "Requesting incompatible QoS. No messages will be sent to it" in ROS 2: RELIABILITY, DURABILITY, DEADLINE and LIVELINESS mismatches, measured
excerpt: Which publisher and subscriber QoS pairs deliver and which print the incompatible QoS warning, from BEST_EFFORT sensor data with a RELIABLE subscriber to TRANSIENT_LOCAL and deadline mismatches. Plus what ros2 topic echo and hz subscribe with on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
